source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 11 (timber structures): permissible stress design of sawn timber by strength group (A, B, C) and location of use, with the column formulas and the modification factors of IS 883:1994 that the chapter follows. The stresses are from memory, to be checked against the tables of the BNBC text (section and page numbers too).
